title: thinking of making a map what mods d i use?

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Try to use WorldEdit and Voxel(Sniper).
Maybe you also could use WorldPainter
replies.body_tagged:

replies.author: steven5703
replies.body: Worldpainter works great for terrian based maps. Worldedit is a great tool for all maps, no matter what type of map it is.
replies.body_tagged: Worldpainter works great for terrian based maps. Worldedit is a great tool for all maps, no matter what type of map it is.

replies.author: Lakitue
replies.body: McEdit is also great for custom spawners and such!

replies.body: if you aren't looking on creating your own server, I'd opt for single player commands, although it's on version 1.6

replies.body:
Mmm.
I personally find VoxelSniper extremely helpful for more detailed projects, but if you want stuff done quickly without having to unnecessary work, many many people use WorldEdit.
